ticket.title: Patient registration: Wait for deletions before reporting a successful save
ticket.text:
Patient registration: Wait for deletions before reporting a successful save

## Problem

Patient saves can report success while name, identifier, or attribute deletions are still running. Deletion failures may therefore be missed or only logged to the console.

## Affected code

- Name deletion
- Identifier deletion
- Attribute deletion

## Root cause

The deletion paths use `forEach(async ...)`, which discards the resulting promises. Attribute deletion also catches failures and only logs them. It currently runs inside the synchronous `getPatientAttributes()` method.

## Expected behaviour

The save operation should remain pending until all requested deletions finish. A failed deletion should cause the save to report an error.

## Implementation notes

- Collect and await name and identifier deletion promises.
- Move attribute deletion out of synchronous `getPatientAttributes()` and into an asynchronous save stage.
- Await the attribute deletions.
- Propagate deletion failures through the existing save error handling.
- Complete the local-language-name fix before or alongside this change.

## Acceptance criteria

- Save does not report success while a deletion is pending.
- Name, identifier, and attribute deletions are awaited.
- A failed deletion produces a visible save error.
- Successful deletions allow the save to complete normally.
- Deferred-promise tests cover pending, successful, and failed deletions.

Verified against `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `c64fb3366119833e9e09a0eb31d580c9e1558d8b`.
